AssetFileMetadata_document_identity_chec.name: AssetFileMetadata_document_identity_check
AssetFileMetadata_document_identity_chec.value: ((((jsonb_typeof(document) = 'object'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((document -> '_id'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND ((document ->> '_id'::text) = "assetId") AND (jsonb_typeof((document -> 'revision'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND ((document ->> 'revision'::text) = revision)) IS TRUE))

columns.expression: (CASE WHEN ((strpos(reverse(name), '.'::text) = ANY (ARRAY[0, 1])) OR (((length(name) - strpos(reverse(name), '.'::text)) + 1) = 1)) THEN ''::text ELSE lower(reverse(split_part(reverse(name), '.'::text, 1))) END)

public.ApprovedMarketplaceProduct.definition: SELECT DISTINCT ON (build."projectId") build."projectId", build."marketplaceProduct", ( SELECT auth.token FROM "AuthorizationToken" auth WHERE auth."projectId" = build."projectId" AND auth.relation = 'viewers'::"AuthorizationRelation" ORDER BY auth.token LIMIT 1) AS "authorizationToken" FROM "Build" build WHERE build.deployment IS NOT NULL AND (build."projectId" IN ( SELECT "Project".id FROM "Project" WHERE "Project"."isDeleted" = false AND "Project"."marketplaceApprovalStatus" = 'APPROVED'::text::"MarketplaceApprovalStatus")) ORDER BY build."projectId", build."createdAt" DESC, build.id
public.ApprovedMarketplaceProduct.name: ApprovedMarketplaceProduct

public.DashboardProject.definition: SELECT "Project".id, "Project".title, "Project".tags, "Project".domain, "Project"."userId", "Project"."workspaceId", "Project"."isDeleted", "Project"."createdAt", "Project"."previewImageAssetId", "Project"."marketplaceApprovalStatus", (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM "Build" WHERE "Build"."projectId" = "Project".id AND "Build".deployment IS NOT NULL)) AS "isPublished" FROM "Project"
public.DashboardProject.name: DashboardProject

public.LatestStaticBuildPerProject.definition: SELECT DISTINCT ON (bld."projectId") bld.id AS "buildId", bld."projectId", bld."updatedAt", bld."publishStatus" FROM "Build" bld WHERE bld.deployment IS NOT NULL AND (bld.deployment::jsonb ->> 'destination'::text) = 'static'::text ORDER BY bld."projectId", bld."createdAt" DESC, bld.id
public.LatestStaticBuildPerProject.name: LatestStaticBuildPerProject

public.published_builds.definition: SELECT build.id AS "buildId", build."projectId", build."createdAt", ( SELECT string_agg(list.value, ', '::text) AS string_agg FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(build.deployment::jsonb -> 'domains'::text) list(value)) AS domains FROM "Build" build WHERE build.deployment IS NOT NULL AND build."isCleaned" = false ORDER BY build."projectId", build."createdAt" DESC
public.published_builds.name: published_builds

public.UserProduct.definition: ( SELECT tl."userId", tl."subscriptionId", tl."productId", tl."customerId", tl."customerEmail" FROM "TransactionLog" tl WHERE tl.status = 'complete'::text AND tl."eventType" = 'checkout.session.completed'::text AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM "TransactionLog" failed WHERE failed."eventType" = 'checkout.session.async_payment_failed'::text AND (failed."eventData" #>> '{data,object,id}'::text[]) = (tl."eventData" #>> '{data,object,id}'::text[]) AND failed."eventCreated" >= tl."eventCreated")) AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM "TransactionLog" tlexsists WHERE tlexsists."subscriptionId" = tl."subscriptionId" AND tlexsists."eventType" = 'customer.subscription.deleted'::text AND tlexsists.status = 'canceled'::text AND tlexsists."eventCreated" > tl."eventCreated")) AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM "TransactionLog" tlexsists WHERE tlexsists."paymentIntent" = tl."paymentIntent" AND tlexsists."eventType" = 'charge.refunded'::text AND tlexsists.status = 'succeeded'::text AND tlexsists."eventCreated" > tl."eventCreated")) ORDER BY tl."userId", tl."eventCreated" DESC) UNION ALL SELECT "TransactionLog"."userId", "TransactionLog"."subscriptionId", "TransactionLog"."productId", "TransactionLog"."customerId", "TransactionLog"."customerEmail" FROM "TransactionLog" WHERE "TransactionLog"."eventType" = 'appsumo.activate'::text
public.UserProduct.name: UserProduct

public.user_publish_count.definition: SELECT DISTINCT "Project"."userId" AS user_id, count(*) AS count FROM "Build" LEFT JOIN "Project" ON "Project".id = "Build"."projectId" WHERE date_trunc('day'::text, "Build"."createdAt") = date_trunc('day'::text, now()) AND "Build".deployment IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "Project"."userId"
public.user_publish_count.name: user_publish_count

public.WorkspaceProjectAuthorization.definition: SELECT w."userId", p.id AS "projectId", 'own'::text AS relation FROM "Workspace" w JOIN "Project" p ON p."workspaceId" = w.id WHERE w."isDeleted" = false AND p."isDeleted" = false UNION ALL SELECT wm."userId", p.id AS "projectId", wm.relation::text AS relation FROM "WorkspaceMember" wm JOIN "Workspace" w ON w.id = wm."workspaceId" JOIN "Project" p ON p."workspaceId" = wm."workspaceId" WHERE wm."removedAt" IS NULL AND w."isDeleted" = false AND p."isDeleted" = false
public.WorkspaceProjectAuthorization.name: WorkspaceProjectAuthorization
